answer.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ. Memory_86 and memory_31 both demonstrate that simplification of onboarding flows drives meaningful, durable improvements in early-stage activation. These directly address the current degradation. Verifying these two memories will confirm the magnitude of past effects and whether the implementation details remain applicable. Memory_91 reinforces that activation messaging compounds these gains. Simplify_onboarding is preferable to promotional_pricing because: (1) pricing pressure from competitors is a sign to compete on value delivery, not race-to-bottom pricing, which risks margin and long-term positioning; (2) memory_73 shows 40% discounts drive volume but only +18% revenue lift—not sustainable for primary objective; (3) simplifying onboarding addresses the direct metric declines without requiring heavy discounting. Referral_incentive (memory_57) works best in established cohorts, not for addressing QoQ activation decline. Enterprise_sales_assist is orthogonal to the current SMB-driven problem. A standard_experiment scale allows confident measurement while preserving ability to iterate if needed.
